text:
alice.h: quick check — saw gpu-high-mem-prod alert spam at 03:12 UTC. Need to debug before next canary. Where do folks usually look for SM% / KV cache traces and the panels i can share?

ben.k: Dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.net/d/gpu-overview. Panels: "SM Util %" (panel id 23), "GPU memory (GB)" (id 19), "KV cache evictions" (id 42). Jaeger traces: https://jaeger.redwood.net/search?service=runtime

carla: For quick metric queries use these in Prometheus:
```
# approximate SM utilization
(sum(rate(nvidia_gpu_utilization_sm_percent_total[1m])) by (instance))

# kvcache eviction rate per pod
increase(redwood_kvcache_evictions_total[5m])
```

dave: re: alert tuning — gpu-high-mem-prod is 85%/5m. It fired on short spike from nightly eval job. Suggest either raise to 92% or change to `for: 10m` to reduce noise. I can open a PR. pinging @carla to own the PR and coords with infra.

carla: I can take it. Will open a PR w/ both options and we can pick in review. Proposed change: threshold -> 92, eval -> 10m, and add a runbook link.

alerts-bot: Incident created: #IO-7893 gpu-high-mem-prod — assigned to carla

alice.h: thanks — please include the Grafana panel urls and the Jaeger link in the PR description. Also add a note about the nightly eval job so SRE can exclude if needed.

ben.k: tagging the panel quick links: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/gpu-overview?viewPanel=23 and https://grafana.redwood.net/d/gpu-overview?viewPanel=42

carla: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/runtime-configs/pull/4521 — includes threshold bump, `for: 10m`, and runbook stub.

dave: i volunteered to do the canary once it's merged. ping me when ready, i have capacity tonight.

alice.h: :thumbsup: perfect. closing loop — will update the oncall doc and drop a note in #incidents if it flaps again.
